title: Getting started with this console
subtitle: A guide to navigating Atharva Bedekar's portfolio

sections.heading: What is this?
sections.body: This is a personal portfolio built to look and feel exactly like the AWS Management Console. Each AWS service maps to a section of my work — projects, documents, skills, and experience.

sections.heading: How to navigate
sections.body: Use the top navigation bar to switch regions. Mumbai (ap-south-1) = professional internship work. Raipur (ap-south-17) = college, personal, and open source projects. Services in the sidebar link to each section.

sections.heading: Service mapping
sections.body: EC2 → Projects (production systems). S3 → Documents (resumes, certs). IAM → Skills (groups = skill categories, users = work experiences). CloudTrail → Experience timeline.

sections.heading: Regions
sections.body: Global services (IAM, S3, VPC, CloudTrail) are available in both regions. Region-specific services (EC2) will show a 'not available in this region' state if accessed from the wrong region.
